zh: PRESENT：64 位块、80/128 位密钥、31 轮的轻量级 SPN 分组密码。
SPN：代换-置换网络，每轮由非线性代换和线性置换组成。
S-box：4 位到 4 位的非线性置换，PRESENT 每轮并行使用 16 个。
pLayer：固定位置换，把第 i 位移动到第 P(i) 位。
轮密钥：由密钥扩展产生、用于每一轮的 64 位子密钥。
密钥扩展：把 80/128 位主密钥更新为 32 个轮密钥的过程。
PRESENT-80：使用 80 位密钥的版本。
PRESENT-128：使用 128 位密钥的版本。
门等效：硬件实现面积的粗略度量；原论文报告约 1570 GE。
RFID：射频识别标签，PRESENT 的目标受限环境之一。
扩散：位置换和轮函数把局部变化扩展到更多位。
reduced-round 攻击：针对少于完整轮数的密码分析。
en: PRESENT: a lightweight SPN block cipher with a 64-bit block, 80/128-bit keys and 31 rounds.
SPN: substitution-permutation network, with a nonlinear substitution and a linear permutation each round.
S-box: a 4-bit nonlinear permutation; PRESENT uses sixteen in parallel each round.
pLayer: a fixed bit permutation moving bit i to position P(i).
Round key: a 64-bit subkey produced by the key schedule for each round.
Key schedule: the process turning an 80/128-bit master key into 32 round keys.
PRESENT-80: the variant using an 80-bit key.
PRESENT-128: the variant using a 128-bit key.
Gate equivalent: a rough measure of hardware area; the paper reports about 1570 GE.
RFID: radio-frequency identification tags, one target environment for PRESENT.
Diffusion: the permutation and round function spreading a local change to more bits.
Reduced-round attack: cryptanalysis targeting fewer than the full number of rounds.
